name: solidworks-mcp
description: MCP server for Solidworks automation via COM API. Provides sketch, feature, drawing, assembly, sheet metal, dimension, and analysis tools for voice-driven CAD interaction.

tools.name: create_line
tools.description: Create a line segment in the active sketch

tools.name: create_circle
tools.description: Create a circle in the active sketch

tools.name: create_arc
tools.description: Create an arc in the active sketch

tools.name: create_rectangle
tools.description: Create a rectangle in the active sketch

tools.name: create_spline
tools.description: Create a spline curve in the active sketch

tools.name: create_point
tools.description: Create a reference point in the active sketch

tools.name: add_dimension
tools.description: Add a smart dimension to a sketch entity

tools.name: add_constraint
tools.description: Add a geometric constraint between sketch entities

tools.name: extrude_boss
tools.description: Create an extruded boss feature from a sketch

tools.name: extrude_cut
tools.description: Create an extruded cut feature from a sketch

tools.name: revolve_boss
tools.description: Create a revolved boss feature

tools.name: revolve_cut
tools.description: Create a revolved cut feature

tools.name: sweep_boss
tools.description: Create a swept boss feature along a path

tools.name: sweep_cut
tools.description: Create a swept cut feature along a path

tools.name: loft_boss
tools.description: Create a lofted boss feature between profiles

tools.name: loft_cut
tools.description: Create a lofted cut feature between profiles

tools.name: fillet
tools.description: Apply a fillet to selected edges

tools.name: chamfer
tools.description: Apply a chamfer to selected edges

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Create a shell feature by removing faces

tools.name: pattern_linear
tools.description: Create a linear pattern of features or bodies

tools.name: pattern_circular
tools.description: Create a circular pattern of features or bodies

tools.name: mirror
tools.description: Mirror features or bodies about a plane

tools.name: hole_wizard
tools.description: Create a hole wizard feature with standard hole types

tools.name: create_drawing_view
tools.description: Create a drawing view from a model

tools.name: add_dimension_to_drawing
tools.description: Add dimensions to a drawing view

tools.name: add_annotation
tools.description: Add annotations to a drawing (GD&T, surface finish, etc.)

tools.name: insert_bom
tools.description: Insert a bill of materials table on a drawing

tools.name: create_assembly
tools.description: Create a new assembly document

tools.name: insert_component
tools.description: Insert a part or sub-assembly into an assembly

tools.name: add_mate
tools.description: Add a mate constraint between assembly components

tools.name: create_bend
tools.description: Create a bend in a sheet metal part

tools.name: create_flange
tools.description: Create a flange on a sheet metal edge

tools.name: create_lofted_bend
tools.description: Create a lofted bend between two profiles

tools.name: flatten
tools.description: Flatten a sheet metal part for manufacturing

tools.name: run_fea
tools.description: Run a finite element analysis study

tools.name: get_mass_properties
tools.description: Get mass properties of the active model

tools.name: get_bounding_box
tools.description: Get the bounding box dimensions of a model
